species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 12 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
